title: The Dog You Stopped Walking
evidence_boundary: This is a metaphor for self-neglect and the way small acts of self-care are quietly dropped under time pressure. It is not a clinical account of depression and is not a substitute for support from a professional or someone you trust.
desired_movement: From not noticing which parts of your own life have gone quiet to recognizing one of them and giving it ten minutes.
grounding: The closing beats return to a real door, a real threshold, and a question answerable today.
invitation: What's been standing at your door so long that you stopped hearing it?
end_card_question: What in your life stopped asking?
voice_standard: Liam - gentle, unhurried, a friend who noticed something and is saying it carefully. Warm and plain through the setup, quieter on the relief beat, tender and steady through the turn. Never scolding, never clinical. Near-whisper on the final question.

scenes.text: There's something in your life that needs to go outside every day.
scenes.primary_symbol: a leash hanging on a hook beside a dark doorway
scenes.query: a leash hanging on a hook beside a dark doorway

scenes.text: You've been feeding it. That's honestly it. Fed, watered, kept alive.
scenes.primary_symbol: a dog bowl on a kitchen floor, food untouched
scenes.query: a dog bowl on a kitchen floor, food untouched

scenes.text: And I want to be careful here, because nobody in this story is cruel.
scenes.primary_symbol: a quiet tidy hallway in late evening light
scenes.query: a quiet tidy hallway in late evening light

scenes.text: You didn't neglect it on purpose. You got busy. Busy is the most respectable way to disappear.
scenes.primary_symbol: a wall calendar dense with handwriting, pages curling
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic photoreal, a wall calendar dense with handwriting, pages curling, shallow depth of field, restrained practical lighting, muted filmic grade, subtle grain

scenes.text: At first it asked. It stood by the door at the same time every day, in case you'd forgotten.
scenes.primary_symbol: a closed front door seen from low near the floor
scenes.query: a closed front door seen from low near the floor

scenes.text: You said soon. You meant it. Soon is a real word when you say it.
scenes.primary_symbol: a hand reaching toward a doorknob then withdrawing
scenes.query: a hand reaching toward a doorknob then withdrawing
scenes.symbol_query: hand moves magnifying glass across printed words on paper natural side light close up

scenes.text: Then one day it didn't come to the door. And you felt relief, which is the part that should scare you.
scenes.primary_symbol: an empty spot on a worn rug, a faint indentation left behind
scenes.query: an empty spot on a worn rug, a faint indentation left behind

scenes.text: Because something that stops asking isn't content. It has just stopped expecting.
scenes.primary_symbol: a still shape lying down facing away in a dim room
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic photoreal, a still shape lying down facing away in a dim room, shallow depth of field, restrained practical lighting, muted filmic grade, subtle grain

scenes.text: So what is it, in your life, that stopped asking?
scenes.primary_symbol: a guitar case closed at the back of a cluttered closet
scenes.query: a guitar case closed at the back of a cluttered closet

scenes.text: For some people it's the guitar. For some it's the friend they keep meaning to call.
scenes.primary_symbol: a phone face down on a table, screen dark
scenes.query: a phone face down on a table, screen dark

scenes.text: For some it's just being outside for ten minutes with nothing to accomplish.
scenes.primary_symbol: an empty park bench in low afternoon sun
scenes.query: an empty park bench in low afternoon sun
scenes.symbol_query: one real door opens while neighboring doors remain closed in bright lived-in hallway

scenes.text: These sound small. That's exactly why they go. Nobody cancels the big things first.
scenes.primary_symbol: a stack of small unopened envelopes on a counter
scenes.query: a stack of small unopened envelopes on a counter

scenes.text: You cancel the thing nobody is expecting you at.
scenes.primary_symbol: one chair pulled slightly away from a set table
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic photoreal, one chair pulled slightly away from a set table, shallow depth of field, restrained practical lighting, muted filmic grade, subtle grain

scenes.text: And the strange arithmetic is that you can keep every promise you made to other people and still be in default.
scenes.primary_symbol: an open ledger with every line checked but one
scenes.query: an open ledger with every line checked but one

scenes.text: You're not lazy. You're loyal. You just aimed it away from yourself.
scenes.primary_symbol: a painted arrow on pavement pointing away into distance
scenes.query: a painted arrow on pavement pointing away into distance

scenes.text: Here's what I keep coming back to. It's still by the door.
scenes.primary_symbol: a shaft of light under a closed door with something waiting
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic photoreal, a shaft of light under a closed door with something waiting in it, shallow depth of field, restrained practical lighting, muted filmic grade, subtle grain

scenes.text: Not standing there. Not asking. But it never actually left the house.
scenes.primary_symbol: a coat still hanging exactly where it was left
scenes.query: a coat still hanging exactly where it was left

scenes.text: Waiting isn't the same as gone. Quiet isn't the same as dead.
scenes.primary_symbol: a plant in low light with one new pale leaf
scenes.query: a plant in low light with one new pale leaf

scenes.text: And nothing about this requires you to become a different person by Monday.
scenes.primary_symbol: a plain kitchen at dawn, a kettle steaming
scenes.query: a plain kitchen at dawn, a kettle steaming
scenes.symbol_query: seed germinates and roots spread through dark soil time lapse with soft daylight

scenes.text: It doesn't need an apology. It needs the door open and ten minutes.
scenes.primary_symbol: a door opening onto ordinary daylight
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic photoreal, a door opening onto ordinary daylight, shallow depth of field, restrained practical lighting, muted filmic grade, subtle grain

scenes.text: So not a resolution. Just a question you can answer today.
scenes.primary_symbol: a leash lifted off its hook and held in one hand
scenes.query: a leash lifted off its hook and held in one hand

scenes.text: What's been standing at your door so long that you stopped hearing it?
scenes.primary_symbol: morning light spreading across an empty threshold
scenes.query: morning light spreading across an empty threshold
